newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Organisation of the Islamic Conference meeting calls for defending Jerusalem.
- Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Electricity has approved 61 industrial projects worth two billion riyals.
- Saudi beheads five Nigerians in the holy city of Mecca for armed robbery.
- Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Abdullah meets Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani in Pakistan.
- Arab National Bank shareholders to decide on Monday on a plan to increase paid-up capital to 1.5 billion riyals.
